visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a night exterior shot of a modern restaurant building, featuring red and white cladding panels under bright spotlights and a black entrance canopy. (2) The scene transitions indoors where a female staff member in a red uniform serves guests at a large round table within a grand, warmly lit dining hall. (3) A series of rapid close-up shots showcase signature dishes: stir-fried shrimp with crispy garlic and a whole roasted chicken presented in a decorative brown wire birdcage. (4) Hands using a knife and fork slice the crispy skin of the chicken; this is followed by views of fried seafood on a shell-shaped plate and a steaming pot of vermicelli with fish. (5) Further dishes are presented, including a plate of stir-fried rice noodles with pork and a large pot of squid rice noodles with cabbage and mushrooms. (6) Dim sum highlights follow, featuring close-ups of siu mai topped with roe, a custard bun being pulled apart to reveal molten yellow filling, and sliced fried taro rolls with sesame. (7) The final sequence shows a wide shot of the grand dining hall with chandeliers and an exterior view with text overlays showing the restaurant's address and social media handle.
